# Deployment results, October and November 2026 (generated by tools/deploy/make_report.py)

Frozen checkpoints, no retraining. Windows are by target date: oct_2026 = 2026-10-01 … 10-31; nov_2026 = 2026-11-01 … the data cutoff. "n too small" = fewer than 10 independent scoring units, so no significance verdict is issued (one month is not enough; see docs/deploy_2026_10_11.md).
